Five sentences, and the contradiction is the standard evenness argument: a squared even implies a even, which forces b even, contradicting lowest terms.

Worst-case bounds match: binary search Theta(log n), heapify Theta(n), mergesort Theta(n log n), quicksort Theta(n^2), BFS on a tree Theta(n).
Given exactly 3 heads in 10 fair flips, the first flip is a head with probability 3/10.
6 and 7 are coprime, so the largest nonrepresentable nonnegative combination is 6*7-6-7=29.

For right-associated x^(x^x), the derivative at 1 is 1.
